summary.headline: Astrological Judgments on Slavery and Birth
summary.text: Catalog entries 285–298 from an Angelican codex, covering tribute, enslavement and its end, migration, fertility and childlessness, embryo sex and gestation, illness, slaves fleeing or being freed, and parental death. Cross-references cite Codices Venetus 5 and Vindobonensis 4; entries also name Aleim son of Isaac, Maseris the Persian, and Muhamates the Balkhian.
